evidence: Read spec S9 (b) (own-rdd.md line 54) and the T8b row (line 151) in the review worktree. The codex argument list in codexexec.go:442-444 matches S9 (b) exactly: exec --sandbox read-only --model --cd --skip-git-repo-check --ephemeral --ignore-user-config --output-last-message <scratch>/last-message.txt -.

The stdin is the instructions, a blank line and the brief; the environment is the options' environment, and the scratch directory comes from os.MkdirTemp with a deferred os.RemoveAll. The reply read is capped at review.MaxReplyBytes+1. Every failure path after the instructions are read wraps app.ErrReviewerDidNotAnswer, names codex and repeats stderr, bounded to 2000 bytes.

Traced CodexInstructions/readMultiline by reading the code, against the escapes tomlMultiline writes. Closing runs of 3 to 5 quotes decode correctly, and the tests cover a body ending in one or two quotes, a run of four, and a backslash. The tests were not run, since I am read-only.

The piguard change writes a refusing codex using the same script and marker as pi. The source scan also refuses exec.Command of codex. The codexexec tests use only a fake runner, and TestNoTestOfThisPackageStartsCodex plus TestMain with testhome pin that.
engine/architecture_test.go puts review/codexexec in the Adapter ring.
The only nit is an unused lastExists field in the test's fakeRunner. The next commit removes it.
